title: ServiceNow Lead Developer
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

Crowe is seeking an experienced **ServiceNow Implementation Lead** to design, develop, and implement scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform. This hands-on role will focus on developing enterprise applications, automating business processes, integrating external systems, and delivering high-quality solutions that enable clients to maximize the value of the Now Platform. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with consulting skills and enjoys solving complex business challenges through innovative platform development.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, configure, and maintain scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform using platform development best practices.
* Develop custom applications, workflows, integrations, and reusable components leveraging JavaScript, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Script Includes, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, and other platform capabilities.
* Configure and extend ServiceNow applications, including but not limited to ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, IRM, and custom applications based on client requirements.
* Develop and maintain REST and SOAP integrations with internal and third-party enterprise systems.
* Design and optimize Service Catalog offerings, workflows, record producers, and self-service experiences using Employee Center, Service Portal, and UI Builder.
* Build and support Workspace experiences, Next Experience components, and mobile capabilities.
* Design and maintain data models, CMDB structures, and Common Service Data Model (CSDM) relationships where applicable.
* Implement platform security using ACLs, application scoping, roles, and security best practices.
* Collaborate with solution architects and technical leads to develop scalable, maintainable, and upgrade-friendly platform solutions.
* Translate business requirements into technical designs and implementation plans using Agile methodologies.
* Perform code reviews, troubleshoot complex platform issues, optimize performance, and support testing and deployment activities.
* Utilize source control, update set management, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps best practices to support application lifecycle management.
* Lead technical discussions, client workshops, and design sessions while providing guidance on ServiceNow platform capabilities and best practices.
* Produce clear technical documentation, development standards, and implementation artifacts.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes and coding standards.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional software development or platform engineering experience, hands-on ServiceNow development experience.
* Experience designing, developing, and implementing enterprise solutions on the ServiceNow platform.
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow architecture, platform capabilities, and application development best practices.
* Experience working within Agile delivery methodologies.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and consulting skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree
* Certification in ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong JavaScript development skills and proficiency with ServiceNow scripting APIs and development frameworks.
* Experience with Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, App Engine Studio, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspace development.
* Certifications in any of the following:
  + ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  + One or more ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications (ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, IRM, or other product areas)
  + ITIL Foundation Certification
* Experience building and supporting REST/SOAP integrations and API-based solutions.
* Knowledge of platform security, application scoping, ACLs, and governance best practices.
* Experience with CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, or Service Mapping is preferred.
* Familiarity with source control, Git, update sets, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
* Understanding of ITIL concepts and enterprise service management processes.
* Experience developing across multiple ServiceNow product areas is highly desirable.
* Ability to lead technical solution design while mentoring other developers.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  
  
**How You Can Grow:**  
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  
  
**More about Crowe:**

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Senior Cloud Service Engineer
description:
**Job title: Senior Cloud Service Engineer**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a motivated **Cloud Service Engineer** to join the Digital Workplace Services team and support the security, administration and governance of our cloud and SaaS environment. The role will work across platforms including **Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, Box** and other enterprise SaaS applications, supporting operational security, access governance, monitoring, troubleshooting and continuous improvement.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to build hands-on experience across **cloud security, identity, SaaS security, data protection and AI security** within a large enterprise environment, working closely with senior engineers, security teams, platform owners, application teams and vendors.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **SaaS & Cloud Security:** Support administration, security governance, onboarding, configuration, lifecycle management and periodic reviews for Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Box, Lucidchart, Smartsheet and other enterprise SaaS platforms.
* **Identity & Access Management:** Support Microsoft Entra ID and Google Cloud Identity administration, including users, groups, applications, Conditional Access, MFA, authentication methods, guest access and privileged role governance.
* **Data Protection & Security Operations:** Assist with Microsoft Purview, Defender, DLP alert monitoring, external sharing reviews, security triage, remediation tracking and operational reporting.
* **AI & Emerging Technology Security:** Support governance and monitoring for enterprise AI services, Copilot, Copilot Studio, GenAI applications, agents, connectors and related data protection controls.
* **Security Monitoring & Investigation:** Monitor dashboards and alerts across SaaS and cloud platforms, perform initial investigation, use tools such as Defender, Purview, Sentinel and SaaS security platforms, and escalate complex issues where required.
* **Platform Operations & Troubleshooting:** Provide second-line support for authentication, provisioning, synchronization, SSO, SAML, SCIM, OAuth, API integrations, vendor issues, change implementation and validation.
* **Governance, Documentation & Improvement:** Maintain inventories, ownership records, runbooks, knowledge articles, configuration records and operational procedures while identifying automation and process improvement opportunities.

**Key Technologies**

The role will have exposure to the following technology areas:

* **Identity & Cloud:** Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Azure, Google Cloud Identity and Google Workspace.
* **Security:** Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Cloud Apps, Conditional Access, DLP and SaaS security/application governance.
* **SaaS Platforms:** Box, Lucidchart, Smartsheet, Adobe Apps and other enterprise SaaS applications.
* **AI Security:** Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI / AI Foundry, AI governance and data protection controls.
* **Automation & Technical Tools:** PowerShell, KQL, Power Automate, REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, SAML, SCIM and OAuth.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in cloud administration, SaaS administration, IT security, identity management or a related technical role.
* Basic understanding of Microsoft 365 and/or Azure, identity and access management, SSO, MFA and authentication concepts.
* Understanding of security fundamentals, including access control, least privilege, data protection and operational security monitoring.
* Good troubleshooting and analytical skills, including the ability to investigate issues using logs, dashboards and administrative portals.
* Basic PowerShell or scripting knowledge, with willingness to learn KQL and security monitoring tools.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, ability to work with technical teams and vendors, and strong attention to detail in documentation.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Purview, Defender, Sentinel/KQL, Google Workspace Administration, Google Cloud Identity, Box administration/Box Shield, SaaS security or CASB.
* Experience with OAuth application governance, SAML, SCIM, Microsoft Graph, PowerShell, Power Automate, cloud security, DLP, AI security or AI governance.

Relevant Microsoft, Google, security or cloud certifications would be advantageous but are not mandatory.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Independently handle routine SaaS and cloud security operations.
* Identify and resolve common identity, access, platform configuration and security alert issues.
* Maintain accurate application, access, security governance and remediation records.
* Improve documentation, repeatable processes, automation and operational efficiency.
* Develop deeper expertise across Microsoft, Google, SaaS, cloud, data protection and AI security platforms.

**Working Relationships**

The role will work closely with Digital Workplace Services, Cyber Security/SOC, Identity & Access Management, Microsoft 365/Azure engineering teams, Google Cloud/Google Workspace teams, Data Protection/Privacy, Application and Enterprise Architecture teams, SaaS application owners and external technology vendors.

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for someone who is **curious, technically hands-on, security-minded and willing to learn** . The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in IT, cloud or security and wants to develop into a broader SaaS, Cloud and AI Security Engineer.

* Enjoys troubleshooting complex technical problems and learning new platforms quickly.
* Takes ownership of issues while knowing when to seek guidance.
* Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Has strong attention to detail and follows through on operational tasks.
* Is interested in emerging technologies, particularly cloud and AI security.

**Who we are:**

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp.pearson.com.

This role is ideal for professionals with **5\+ years of experience** who are ready to step into a **manager\-level capacity**—driving technical support, mentoring junior team members, and contributing to solution delivery while remaining deeply involved in hands\-on work.


As part of our India\-based delivery team, you will collaborate closely with global teams to deliver high\-quality support and enhancements across enterprise\-scale Dynamics implementations.

* Contribute to internal knowledge assets such as SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and operational runbooks.

* Participate in knowledge\-sharing sessions, team learning, and cross\-functional collaboration.

**Leadership, Collaboration \& Communication**

* Strong experience identifying and resolving performance, functional, and integration issues across the F\&O stack (SQL DB, AOS, services, SSRS reports).
* Solid proficiency in **X\+\+ development**, OOP principles, performance optimization, and scalable design.
* Experience with **source control and CI/CD pipelines** (Git, Azure DevOps).

* Excellent English communication skills with the ability to interface directly with global stakeholders.
* Ability to operate with moderate supervision and take ownership of assigned tasks.
* The ideal candidate must be flexible and willing to work varying shifts between 2:30 PM and 5:30 AM.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with REST/OData services, Dual\-write integrations, and middleware technologies.
* Exposure to monitoring and telemetry tools such as **LCS monitoring**, **Application Insights**, **Azure Monitor**, and **Power BI**.

description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Magento Developer** who is passionate about troubleshooting, debugging, and providing technical support for large\-scale e\-commerce systems.  
This is a **hands\-on technical support engineering role** focused on diagnosing, resolving, and preventing complex issues in **Magento/Adobe Commerce** environments.  
If you have strong **Magento development skills** and are open to transitioning into a **technical support\-oriented career path**, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the **primary technical contact** for Magento application issues, incidents, and performance problems.
* **Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve** issues across the stack — application, web server, and database layers.
* Work extensively with **Linux\-based environments** to analyze logs, processes, and configurations.
* Manage and optimize **Magento hosting environments** involving **Apache/Nginx**, **PHP\-FPM**, **MySQL**, **Redis**, and **Elasticsearch**.
* Handle **networking and infrastructure components** — including **DNS configurations, SSL certificates, CDN integrations, and reverse proxies**.
* Collaborate with developers, DevOps, and cloud teams to reproduce and resolve critical issues.
* Monitor system performance, automate diagnostics, and identify root causes of recurring incidents.
* Document fixes, maintain internal knowledge base articles, and suggest improvements to enhance customer experience.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **2\+ years of hands\-on experience in Magento (Open Source or Adobe Commerce)** development or implementation.
* Strong command over **PHP, MySQL, HTML/CSS, and JavaScript** within the Magento ecosystem.
* Excellent understanding of **Linux command line**, shell scripting, and server administration.
* Working experience with **Apache or Nginx web servers** — configuring vhosts, SSL, redirects, caching, etc.
* Familiarity with **network\-level concepts** — DNS, CDN, SSL/TLS, load balancing, and firewalls.
* Ability to analyze application logs, web server logs, and error reports.
* Strong debugging mindset with a focus on **root cause analysis**.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills for interacting with clients and internal teams.

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to **Adobe Commerce Cloud**, **AWS**, or **Azure** environments.
* Understanding of **CI/CD pipelines**, **Git**, and **containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)**.
* Familiarity with **performance optimization and security hardening** for Magento.

**Who Should Apply**

* Magento Developers looking to **expand into a technical support or site reliability** path.
* Engineers who enjoy **problem\-solving, system diagnostics, and performance tuning** more than feature development.
* Candidates who take ownership, communicate clearly, and thrive in **high\-impact support environments**.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹800,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* What is your current CTC ?
* What is your expected CTC ?
* What is your notice period ?
* Are you willing to work in a Magento Technical Support role ?

title: Shopify/Webflow Developer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a skilled and creative Shopify / Webflow Developer with 1–2 years of hands\-onexperience to join our development team. The ideal candidate should have experience building, customizing, and maintaining responsive e\-commerce and business websites using Shopify and Webflow.

The candidate will work closely with designers, project managers, and other developers to deliver high\-quality, user\-friendly, responsive, and performance\-oriented websites.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, customize, and maintain websites using Shopify and Webflow.
* Customize Shopify themes, templates, sections, and layouts according to project requirements.
* Develop responsive and visually appealing websites using Webflow.
* Convert Figma/PSD designs into responsive Shopify/Webflow websites.
* Work with Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for theme customization.
* Configure Shopify stores, products, collections, navigation, and basic store settings.
* Integrate third\-party apps, plugins, APIs, and other required tools.
* Troubleshoot and resolve website, layout, functionality, and compatibility issues.
* Optimize websites for speed, responsiveness, SEO, and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Ensure websites are responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to ensure accurate implementation of designs.
* Work with project managers and team members to understand requirements and deliver projects within timelines.
* Perform website testing, debugging, and quality checks before deployment.
* Maintain and update existing Shopify and Webflow websites as required.
* Stay updated with the latest Shopify, Webflow, e\-commerce, and web development trends.

**Required Skills**

* 1–2 years of professional experience in Shopify and/or Webflow development.
* Good hands\-on experience with Shopify theme customization.
* Basic to good knowledge of Shopify.
* Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
* Hands\-on experience with Webflow CMS and responsive website development.
* Experience converting Figma/PSD designs into functional websites.
* Good understanding of responsive design principles.
* Knowledge of website performance optimization and basic SEO.
* Experience with Shopify apps, integrations, and third\-party tools.
* Good debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Understanding of cross\-browser and cross\-device compatibility.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
